brand.name: Coursly
brand.tagline: Find the right tutor. Book. Learn.

marketing.heroTitle: Learn from tutors who fit you
marketing.heroSubtitle: Tell us your subject, level and goal. We match you with verified tutors and show you exactly why each one fits.
marketing.step1Body: A short survey: subject, level, target, language, budget and when you are free.
marketing.step2Body: Ranked tutors with a match score you can actually read — subject, level and goal weigh most.
marketing.step3Body: Pick a slot, pay through Stripe, join the classroom from any device.
marketing.forTutorsBody: Set your price and availability, get verified, and receive bookings. Payouts handled by Stripe.
